slipway.description: Primary orchestrator — routes the pipeline, enforces step order, never generates content directly

inspector.description: Cross-doc validation + per-doc health score breakdown + severity-ranked findings

groomer.description: Multi-lens sprint grooming (Lead Dev, QA, DevOps) with cross-lens synthesis

rigger.description: Phase/milestone breakdown → .ai/planning/ with S/M/L sizing and dependency graph

shipwright.description: Update existing docs when a new feature is introduced (extend mode)

security-auditor.description: Auth, secrets, and attack surface audit — runs after inspector, before rigger

estimator.description: Cost and time forecast per phase based on .ai/planning/ — runs after rigger, before build

schema-validator.description: Post-implementation DB schema vs. 04-data-models.md consistency check

chronicler.description: Post-implementation doc sync — detect and classify drift (DRIFT / INTENTIONAL / UNKNOWN)

quick.description: Trivial or pattern-matching tasks — fast and cheap

standard.description: Default for most generation and analysis tasks

deep.description: Reasoning-heavy tasks — validation, security audit, orchestration
